author: fwyzard
body: LZ4 v1.10.0 introduces major updates: - multithreading support - dictionary compression and decompression - new "medium" compression level 2 For the full set of changes since LZ4 v1.9.2, see: - https://github.com/lz4/lz4/releases#release-v1.10.0 - https://github.com/lz4/lz4/releases#release-v1.9.4 - https://github.com/lz4/lz4/releases#release-v1.9.3 LZ4 v1.10.0 is 1-2% faster than 1.9.2 for levels 1-9, and 1% slower at level 12:
title: Update lz4 to v1.10.0
